mode: built-in image_gen with local primary reference images

specs.name: hardware-mark1
specs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: recognizable hardware choice illustration for an OpenVoiceOS setup wizard.
Primary request: Translate the photographed real device in the supplied reference into a single friendly, precise product DRAWING. Preserve the actual hardware identity, silhouette, proportions, component placement and recognizable details. Make it clearly hand-drawn editorial vector-like illustration rather than photography or a glossy 3D toy: confident clean dark-navy contour lines, simplified interior detail, restrained flat color fills, very subtle two-tone cel shading, crisp well-finished edges. Friendly, modern, grown-up.
Composition: one complete isolated device only, centered on a square 1024x1024 canvas, three-quarter view with a slightly elevated camera. Entire device must be visible with a clear 10% transparent margin on all sides. Background must be genuinely transparent alpha, with no backdrop, no floor, no solid white rectangle, no checkered background, no shadow outside the device. Keep physical white body parts opaque.
Color palette: preserve the real hardware colors in the reference; use a cool white and pale blue-gray for white parts, charcoal/navy for dark parts, vivid cyan for illuminated screens/eyes, natural green circuit boards and silver ports. No coral colors.
Constraints: no labels, text, numbers, annotations, captions, brand wordmarks or logos; no new accessories or invented components; do not crop; no collage, no additional views. Remove the source photo's surrounding environment, labels, arrows, and background.
Input image 1 is the exact Mycroft Mark I identity and shape reference.
Subject invariants: the actual Mark I is a LOW WIDE WHITE CAPSULE enclosure with a BLACK HORIZONTAL OVAL FACE, FOUR SHORT FEET (three visible in this view), a round top control knob and subtle top perforations. Two CYAN SEGMENTED CIRCULAR LED RING EYES at left and right, with a small WHITE DOT-MATRIX SMILE between them. Keep the real squat width-to-height ratio and rounded rear depth shown in the reference. Show its front and left side in approximately the reference angle. Do not turn it into an upright cylindrical speaker or a generic round robot head. Simplify the dotted face while preserving its distinctive rings and dotted smile.
